student_learning_goal: I can sort, build, match, and follow movement directions.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can sort, build, match, and follow movement directions.
header.character_watermark: Trekker Tig and Compass Coco in the top-right with geometry tools. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Name 4 solids and write number of FACES for each.
parts.visual_layout: Four solid icons with a name line and faces line under each.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 capstone sort layout for geometry worksheet, B&W line art. 4 solid icons: cube, square pyramid, cylinder, cone. Each with a name line and faces line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P1_SORT at Part 1: keywords name the solid icons sort task.

parts.student_instructions: Decompose 1 structure into 3 parts. Find 1 congruent pair of faces.
parts.visual_layout: Structure illustration with a parts list and a congruent-pair box.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 capstone decompose-and-match layout for geometry worksheet, B&W line art. 1 structure (tower of cube + prism + pyramid). Below: 'Parts: ___, ___, ___'. Below: 'Congruent face pair: ___.'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P2_BUILD at Part 2: keywords name the structure parts and congruent match task.

parts.answer_key: Parts: cube, prism, pyramid. Congruent: any same-size faces.

parts.student_instructions: Start at A. Follow: 4 right + quarter turn + 3 forward + half turn + 2 forward. Where do you END?
parts.visual_layout: A 6x6 map grid with start position A marked.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 capstone map grid for geometry worksheet, B&W line art. 6x6 grid with A at top-left and treasure spots scattered. Below: 'I ended at ___.'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P3_MAP at Part 3: keywords name the map grid follow task.

parts.answer_key: Final spot depends on grid layout — teacher pre-marks.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, design your own 5-step treasure hunt for a friend.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone. Summative artifact — score on rubric.
